en.headline: Privacy watchdog investigates data breaches at three firms affecting over 1,600
en.dek: The Office of the Privacy Commissioner confirmed notifications from Hong Kong Airlines, YOHO Hong Kong and Broadway Photo, and has received 23 complaints so far.
body: The Office of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data said it had received data-breach notifications this month from Hong Kong Airlines, YOHO Hong Kong and Broadway Photo Equipment, involving more than 1,600 residents in total, and had opened investigations.

Hong Kong Airlines reported a breach affecting 815 passengers who travelled between 29 September and 22 October. Exposed details included names, telephone numbers, travel dates, flight numbers and routes. YOHO Hong Kong’s notification covered 790 customers who placed orders between 29 September and 12 October, with names, phone numbers, delivery addresses, order numbers and purchase details among the data involved.

The commissioner received the Broadway notification on 26 October. By that date the office had logged 23 complaints and 20 inquiries linked to the three incidents. It advised residents who receive calls claiming to be from the companies to verify the caller through official channels, refuse unexpected transfer requests, and avoid disclosing bank-account numbers or passwords.

zh.headline: 私隱專員公署調查三間公司資料外洩 涉逾1600名市民
zh.dek: 公署證實接獲香港航空、友和香港及百老滙通報，至今共收到23宗投訴及20宗查詢，已展開調查。
body: 私隱專員公署表示，本月分別接獲香港航空、友和香港及百老滙攝影器材的資料外洩事故通報，合共涉及超過1600名市民的個人資料，署方已展開調查。
香港航空的通報涉及815名於9月29日至10月22日期間出發的乘客，外洩資料包括姓名、電話號碼、航班日期、航班編號及航線。友和香港則涉及790名於9月29日至10月12日下單的客戶，資料涵蓋姓名、電話、送貨地址、訂單編號及購買詳情。
公署於10月26日接獲百老滙的通報。截至該日，就三宗事故共收到23宗投訴及20宗查詢。公署提醒市民，若接獲自稱商戶的來電，應透過官方渠道核實身分，拒絕可疑轉帳要求，切勿向他人披露網上銀行帳號及密碼等敏感資料。
